value.rationale: The first trivalent branching geometry and all larger stars are natural, not an artificial numerical slice. The prior main example only showed nonnormaloidity for 5+ rays and explicitly asked when normaloidity fails. A single exact witness closes both 3- and 4-ray cases and yields a uniform strict norm gap for every larger m; this is a substantive boundary fact although the binary case remains open.
